nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: Sit down a minute. I have been trying to say a thing for two days and it comes out wrong every time, so tonight I am going to say it badly and be done with it.

options.text: Say it badly, then.
What did coming out here cost you?
First. Could the one at the crossing tell me where my strays went?
It will keep. The count is short.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: If I go wrong out there. If something at a water gets hold of me and I am still walking around afterward. You put me in the ground, ordinary, and you keep me there. Nobody carries me down to a crossing to be asked questions. Nobody keeps me lit because I was useful. That is what I want from you.

options.text: You have my word.
No. I will not promise that.
Why me? Alvarez is closer.
Before I answer. Could he find my strays?

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: Because Alvarez sets bones and then goes home. Everyone inside forty miles brings me their dying and then goes home too. I am the last face a great many people see. I have thought about who is going to be at mine, and the list came out at one, and you are standing on it.

options.text: You have my word.
There is a second thing. You have had it behind your teeth all night.
options.unavailable: You have not worked a day beside her. Steady three head with her first, then ask her what else she wants.
options.closes_reason: She stopped offering after you asked her to put a frightened man to work.

options.text: What did coming out here cost you?
No. I will not promise that.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: A room with a door that shuts. A brother who used to write. Alvarez offered me a share of his practice at Griffin if I would hand him my instruments and call that a partnership. I do not miss the door as much as I expected to.

options.text: Whatever you are going to ask me for, you have it.
There is a second thing. You have had it behind your teeth all night.
options.unavailable: You have not worked a day beside her. Steady three head with her first, then ask her what else she wants.
options.closes_reason: She stopped offering after you asked her to put a frightened man to work.

options.text: That is your business, not mine.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: One more, then, and it is small and it is stupid. Send for me some day when nobody is dying. A count that will not come out. A bad ford. A day with nothing wrong in it at all. Every person who says my name is already frightened by the time they say it. I would like to hear it flat, once.

options.text: Tomorrow. North line. Nothing wrong with it, and I want you along.
You have my word on the first. The other I cannot swear to.
No. To both.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: No. He is a frightened man standing in the water that killed him. He is not a lantern and he is not a bird dog. Ask me for a poultice. Ask me to sit up with a hand who is coughing. Do not ask me for that.

options.text: He is dead. The strays are not. Ask him.
options.closes_reason: She stopped offering after you asked her to put a frightened man to work.

options.text: Then I will go down and ask him myself.
options.closes_reason: She stopped offering after you told her you would go and bargain with him.

options.text: Fair. Forget I said it.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: I said no. I am not going to say it a third time with a kinder face on. Go down and bargain with him if you want to. Do it knowing exactly what I think of a man who would.

options.text: Understood. I will leave him be.
It is my water and my count.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: Good. I will not raise it again, and I will hold you to it in front of witnesses if it comes to that. That is the first thing anybody has agreed to do for me that does not involve a bandage.

outcome.summary: Eleanor has your word: ordinary ground, and nobody carries her to a crossing.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: The north line. Nothing wrong with it at all. You have no idea what you just agreed to and I am not going to explain it and spoil it. Be at the wagon at first light and do not bring the bag.

outcome.summary: Your word, and a day on the north line with nothing wrong in it.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: All right. I would sooner have a flat no than a yes you would argue yourself out of at the graveside. I will ask Alvarez. He will say yes, and I will not believe him. Go on, your count is short.

outcome.summary: You would not give your word. She did not ask twice, and she did not ask for anything else.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: It will keep. It has kept two days.

outcome.summary: She went back to the kettle. Whatever it was, she is still holding it.

nodes.speaker: ELEANOR
nodes.line: Then we are finished talking tonight. Mind the bank on your way down. It lies.

outcome.summary: You pushed her on the crossing. She stopped asking you for anything.
